_help: 31 images for LONG_01. id = first scene number it covers (see LONG_01_SCENES.md); 'covers' lists all scenes using that image.

looks.dadi: Dadi: Indian grandmother ~70, round face, white hair bun, round golden spectacles, light green saree with yellow border, gold bangles, wooden walking stick, small red bindi
looks.golu: Golu: chubby Indian boy ~10, messy black hair, yellow T-shirt, blue half-pants, white socks, red shoes
looks.mitthu: Mitthu: green parrot with red beak and thin red neck ring
looks.ghasita: Ghasita the greedy sweet-shop owner: very fat 50s man, big round belly in a loose cream kurta, white dhoti, cloth money pouch at the waist, shiny bald head with curly salt-and-pepper hair on the sides, upturned salt-and-pepper handlebar moustache, half-closed greedy eyes
looks.chhotu: Chhotu the kind helper: thin young man, honest open face, gentle big eyes, short neat black hair, light-blue kurta with a small patch on the sleeve, off-white dhoti, barefoot
looks.sadhu: Sadhu Baba: very old thin holy man, long white beard, small white top knot, chandan tilak, rudraksha mala, saffron dhoti and saffron shoulder cloth, wooden lathi, cloth jholi bag
looks.kadhai: the magic brass kadhai: small golden-bronze wok-shaped bowl with two round handles and paisley-and-dot motifs around the rim (exactly as in the kadhai prop sheet)
looks.kid: a poor village boy ~8, thin, torn white vest, brown shorts, barefoot, big hopeful eyes
looks.woman: a village woman customer ~35, pink saree, dupatta over head
looks.man: a village man customer ~40, white kurta, small orange turban
looks.shop: Ghasita's big sweet shop in Rampur bazaar: wooden counter, brass plates piled with orange jalebi and yellow laddoo, a big iron frying pan of oil on a clay mud chulha (no gas stove) at the front, cloth awning
looks.stall: Chhotu's small new jalebi stall: little wooden stall with a thatched roof, one clay mud chulha with an iron pan, a few brass plates of jalebi

base: 16:9 landscape scene for a family-friendly Hindi moral-story cartoon set in an old Indian village (Rampur), flat 2D cartoon, thick bold black outlines, warm colours, flat cel shading. No modern objects (no gas stoves, plastic, phones, vehicles). No text, signs or letters anywhere.

scenes.prompt: Evening in Dadi's courtyard (as in the location reference: mud house, charpai, golden sunset). {golu} sits hugging a big open box of round yellow laddoos tightly to his chest with a greedy happy face. {mitthu} swoops down towards the laddoos, wings spread. Comic mood.

Same evening courtyard. {dadi} sits on the charpai with a warm knowing smile, beckoning with one hand, about to tell a story. {golu} sits on the ground beside her still holding the laddoo box, looking up curiously.

Wide shot of a busy, colourful old Indian village bazaar in daytime. In the centre: {shop}. {ghasita} leans on the counter with a sly greedy grin. Right foreground: big glistening piles of orange jalebi on a brass plate, large and detailed (used for a close-up).

At the counter of the same shop. {woman} waits to buy jalebi. {ghasita} weighs jalebi on a small brass hand-scale while secretly pressing one pan down with his finger to cheat - the finger on the scale clearly visible and large in the frame. On a side tray: dull, old, dry sweets.
Same shop counter. {kid} holds up a few coins in his palm, pleading. {ghasita} scowls and makes a dismissive shooing wave with his hand.
Side of the same shop. {chhotu} stands at the clay mud chulha frying jalebi in the big iron pan with a ladle, kind smile, steam rising. A simple mud chulha with fire, NOT a gas stove.

Side of the same shop. {chhotu} secretly hands a jalebi to {kid} (the same boy as in the reference) behind the counter; the boy beams with joy. In the background {ghasita} is busy counting coins and does not notice.

Same shop under a harsh midday sun (strong light, heat haze). {sadhu}, tired, stands at the counter with folded hands asking for food. {ghasita} angrily waves him away. Leave clear space around the sadhu (used for a close-up).
A big shady neem tree beside the bazaar lane. {sadhu} sits alone under it, cross-legged, tired and hungry, lathi leaning on the trunk, jholi beside him. Quiet, sad mood.
Under the same neem tree. {chhotu} kneels and offers two rotis with both hands to {sadhu}, compassionate.
Under the same neem tree. {sadhu} eats a roti slowly, eyes gently closed, deeply grateful and peaceful. Soft warm light.
Under the same neem tree. {sadhu} smiles and takes {kadhai} out of his jholi; it gives a soft golden glow. {chhotu} watches amazed.
Close-up: {kadhai}, glowing golden with sparkles, held in both hands of {chhotu}, whose amazed face is just above it. On one side {sadhu} raises his palm in blessing, wise smile.

Chhotu's humble corner of a mud hut with a clay mud chulha. {chhotu} has just dropped a handful of flour into {kadhai}; the flour has magically doubled into a big heap with golden sparkles. Chhotu's face full of wonder.
Same hut corner. {chhotu} happily makes rotis on an iron tawa over the clay mud chulha; a tall stack of rotis beside him; the magic kadhai glows softly nearby.
Outside the same hut. A row of happy village children (including the poor boy from the reference) sit eating rotis, cheering with raised hands; {chhotu} serves them, smiling.
{ghasita} peeks from behind a mud wall with narrowed greedy eyes, rubbing his hands; in the background, through a doorway, the magic kadhai glows. Sneaky, suspicious mood.
Night, moonlight through the doorway of the same hut. {chhotu} sleeps peacefully on a mat. {ghasita} tiptoes away clutching the glowing magic kadhai, finger on his lips. Tense but comic, not scary.

Night inside Ghasita's sweet shop lit by a clay diya; an iron safe in the corner, shelves of sweets. {ghasita} holds a gold coin over {kadhai} on the counter with a greedy grin. Inside the kadhai, large in the frame, a lump of brown clay where a coin fell (used for a close-up).
Same shop at night. {ghasita}, angry and frustrated, pours a fistful of gold coins into the kadhai; the coins turn into brown clay lumps as they fall in.

Same shop at night, comic chaos. {ghasita} frantically empties his iron safe, brass sweet trays and silver pots into the kadhai; everything turns into brown clay; clay lumps pile up around him; his face desperate.
Morning inside the same shop: daylight through the door, the whole shop filled with heaps of brown clay. {ghasita} sits on top of a clay heap holding his head in both hands, shocked and sad.

Inside the same shop: the magic kadhai floats in the air and dissolves into golden light and sparkles; a faint, translucent, gentle face of {sadhu} appears in the glow. {ghasita} shields his eyes. Mystical, not scary.
Village lane in daylight. Villagers - men, women and children - gather around {chhotu}, smiling, patting his shoulder, grateful.
Rampur bazaar. Villagers work together to build {stall} for {chhotu}: one ties the thatched roof, one carries planks, children carry a brass plate. Chhotu smiles with happy tears.
{stall}, now busy with a happy crowd. {chhotu} serves jalebi. Left foreground, large: {man} biting a jalebi with a delighted face (used for a close-up).

At {stall}. {chhotu} weighs jalebi on a perfectly balanced brass scale, honest. Beside him a separate brass plate of jalebi set aside for the hungry; poor children (including the boy from the reference) smile nearby.
Evening in the bazaar: Ghasita's once-big shop is now empty, dusty and shut, no sweets, cobweb on the awning. {ghasita} stands outside alone, sad and humbled.
At {stall} in the evening. {chhotu} kindly holds out a jalebi to {ghasita}, who looks surprised and humbled, hands half raised to accept.

Dadi's evening courtyard. {golu} holds out a laddoo to {dadi} with a sheepish, sweet smile. On the charpai, {mitthu} shakes his head comically, large and clear in the right part of the frame (used for a close-up).
Close-up of {dadi} in the courtyard at sunset, warm golden light, gentle wise smile, looking slightly towards the viewer.
